application_details.scheme_name: EE Substation Upgrade Beddington Cross, Croyden

subdivision_of_building:
The existing glazed main entrance door at ground floor level is to be removed entirely, including the glazed sidelights. A new masonry infill is to be installed to close the sidelight openings. A new solid-core, double leaf timber door with vision panels will be installed to replace the original entrance door. 

The new palisade fencing is to be installed externally to the permitter of the fuel tanks and communications tower at site ground level.
